desc:
✈️ Man the anti-aircraft guns and defend the factory! Waves of planes, drones, tanks and bosses are incoming. How long can you hold out?

🏭 FLAK DEFENSE: endless waves, boss fights, night raids and enemy aces
🌊 BEACHHEAD: hold the cliffs against boats, tanks and planes
👥 Play solo or team up with up to 4 players
🎯 Hit glowing weak spots for critical hits
🃏 Pick an upgrade card between waves
🔓 Unlock and upgrade 33 guns in the Armory
💾 Save your run and continue later
🏆 Daily rewards, quests, ranks and leaderboards

🕹️ CONTROLS
PC: Mouse to aim, click to fire, right-click to zoom, 1-7 or wheel to switch guns, Q rockets, F/G/R helpers, U armory, X menu
Mobile: Drag to aim, hold FIRE, LOCK for auto-aim
Controller: Stick to aim, RT fire, LT zoom, LB rockets, B menu
